_source: GODSEYE /api/flight/{callsign} answers and the adsb.lol traces behind them (/api/aircraft/{hex}), plus the flights snapshot rows for vertical rate, captured live by reviewer R4 on 2026-10-01 14:04–14:31Z (phase3/round5). Traces thinned to at most one point per 2 minutes (tuples [t, lat, lng, altFt, onGround, gsKt, trackDeg]) plus every point on the ground or below 3,000 ft and both sides of every coverage gap of 5 min or more (traceLength = points in the original trace). verdict: "wrong" = the aircraft was later seen at or heading to a third airport (round 5 B1), "right" = it flew the reversed pair.
